# Baobab DMC Turkey

> Baobab DMC Turkey is an official B2B Incoming Tour Operator and Destination Management Company (DMC) based in Istanbul, Turkey. Licensed by TURSAB (Association of Turkish Travel Agencies, Group A License No: 12458). We specialize in crafting tailor-made Turkey itineraries, private small group journeys, luxury private gulet yacht charters, VIP cultural expeditions, MICE events, and authentic local experiences across Turkey for international tour operators, travel advisors, and wholesale agencies.

## Overview & Core Identity
- **Company Name**: Baobab DMC Turkey (Baobab Turizm Seyahat Acentası Ltd. Şti.)
- **Industry**: Inbound Travel, Destination Management Company (DMC), B2B Ground Handling Operator
- **Accreditation**: TURSAB Group A License #12458 (Ministry of Culture and Tourism, Republic of Türkiye)
- **Headquarters**: Halaskargazi Cad. No: 142/5, Şişli, 34360 Istanbul, Turkey
- **Regional Field Offices**: Cappadocia (Göreme), Aegean (Kuşadası/Bodrum), Riviera (Antalya)
- **Website**: https://baobabdmc.com
- **Direct B2B Inquiry Email**: info@baobabdmc.com
- **Operations & 24/7 Concierge**: ops@baobabdmc.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +90 (212) 555 0192 / +90 (532) 555 0192

## Core B2B Services
- **Curated Multi-Day Turkey Programs**: 8-to-15 day private and small-group journeys combining Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Turquoise Coast, and Eastern Anatolia.
- **Private Gulet & Coastal Yacht Charters**: Traditional handcrafted wooden Bodrum/Marmaris gulets for private blue cruise expeditions along Fethiye, Göcek, Kaş, and the Lycian coast.
- **VIP Scholar-Guided Cultural Expeditions**: Access to leading art historians, archeologists, and top-tier licensed scholars for Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Ancient Ephesus, Gobeklitepe, and Mount Nemrut.
- **MICE, Corporate & Exclusive Venues**: Historic Cisterns, Bosphorus Ottoman Waterfront Mansions (Yalı), Roman Amphitheaters, and Cappadocia Cave Valleys for gala dinners, executive retreats, and weddings.
- **Bespoke VIP Logistics**: Mercedes VIP Sprinters, private airport tarmac Meet & Greet at IST / SAW / ADB / BJV / NAV, and domestic flight coordination.

## Key Destinations Covered
- **Istanbul**: Historic Peninsula (Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern), Private Bosphorus Yachts, Grand Bazaar & Spice Market culinary walks, Galata & Karaköy contemporary arts.
- **Cappadocia**: Göreme, Love Valley, Pigeon Valley, Rose Valley, Sunrise Hot Air Balloons, Derinkuyu Underground City, Luxury Boutique Cave Suites (Museum Hotel, Argos in Cappadocia), Whirling Dervish rituals at historic Caravanserais.
- **Aegean & Ephesus**: Ancient Ephesus Roman Metropolis (Library of Celsus, Terrace Houses), House of Virgin Mary, Sirince historic Greek wine village, Pamukkale Thermal Travertines & Hierapolis ruins, Pergamon Acropolis.
- **Turquoise Coast & Lycian Shore**: Bodrum Peninsula, Fethiye, Göcek secluded bays, Kaş, Kalkan, Butterfly Valley, Kekova Sunken City kayak & private gulet cruises.
- **Antalya & Mediterranean**: Kaleiçi Old Town, Aspendos Roman Amphitheatre, Perge marble stadiums, Termessos mountaintop ruins, Taurus Mountain overland safaris.
- **Eastern Anatolia & Mesopotamia**: Göbeklitepe (the world's oldest temple complex), Karahantepe, Sanliurfa, Mount Nemrut giant stone heads summit, Mardin stone-carved architecture & Syriac monasteries, Gaziantep culinary UNESCO tours.
- **Black Sea & Highlands**: Trabzon, Sumela Cliffside Monastery, Uzungöl alpine lake, Rize tea plantations, Ayder & Pokut cloud highlands.

## Sample Curated Frameworks
- **Grand Cultural Odyssey of Anatolia (12 Days)**: Istanbul • Cappadocia • Ephesus • Pamukkale • Antalya • Bodrum.
- **Cappadocia Sunrise & Aegean Heritage (8 Days)**: Istanbul • Cappadocia cave suites • Ancient Ephesus marble streets.
- **Turquoise Coast Gulet & Lycian Trail (10 Days)**: Fethiye • Göcek 12 Islands blue cruise • Kaş • Sunken City Kekova.
- **Mesopotamia & Dawn of Civilization (7 Days)**: Gaziantep • Şanlıurfa • Göbeklitepe • Mount Nemrut • Mardin.
